answer: Because the grove release is logged with every signature, the opal audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the mesa graph and each risks its bond. Slashing removes 25 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
